notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is greater than an opponent's.
Auntie Blyte does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion triggers.
Resolve the Volcano Hellion trigger, dealing an amount of damage greater than an opponent's life total to you and to any creature besides Auntie Blyte.
Auntie Blyte triggers, causing you to put a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the damage dealt to you.
Activate Auntie Blyte by paying {1}{R}, tapping them, and removing any number of +1/+1 counters from them, dealing that much damage to that opponent.
